profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Western Governors University
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a contributor and leader of teams delivering scalable and reusable JavaScript.  I'm also experienced and certified in cloud solutions with AWS.  My tech stack knowledge spans across multiple languages and frameworks including Angular/React/Vue on the front end, Node/Java/PHP back end with MySQL/PostgreSQL/Mongo databases.

I have tech lead experience guiding agile teams in daily and weekly scrum meetings.  I'm a fast learner of new technologies and languages.  Looking for companies that value ownership and cultivating continuous growth.

SKILLS
Javascript (Angular, React.js, Node.js, Vue.js) - Advanced
Java (Spring) - Intermediate
C# - Beginner
AWS Serverless (SAM, EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, Cloudfront, CodePipeline, S3) - Advanced
Docker - Advanced
Data (Mysql, Sql, Postgresql, Dynamodb, Mongodb, Graphql) - Advanced

Thanks for viewing my profile.  Please don't hesitate to say hello and check out my old time banjo learning app demo project build with Angular, Node.js and AWS Lambda at banjojammer.com

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site

positions.title: Technical Lead - TypeScript, Angular, Java, Spring, AWS
positions.description:
- Leading daily scrum meetings, coordinating code reviews, deployments and communicating with product to drive Financial Aid development.
- Drove development as team lead of Faculty Allocation Service using TypeScript, Angular, Java, and Spring with PostgreSQL to allocate students for 100% of course assignments across 400 instructors and program mentors.
positions.insights: Angular, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, Java, Spring, AWS
positions.description:
- Architected event driven TypeScript and Angular UI with a Java, Spring, AWS Lambda backend that receives assessment scores and sends result emails to students, saving ~$620,000 annually in instructor hours.
- Engineered Node.js RESTful endpoints in TypeScript to integrate with Salesforce and AWS Lambda for self service enrollment. A $2.4M+ annual impact by removing manual staff labor across 80,000+ enrollments.
- Developed score import tool that parses CSV inputs for a reactive TypeScript and Angular form and saves to AWS MySQL, enabling instructors to score over 400,000 assignments each month.
- Created exam site locator with TypeScript and Angular that uses Open Maps API to show proctor locations.  Cost savings of over $250k per year of admin assistance time emailing site locations to students.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Javascript, TypeScript, Angular, HTML, CSS
positions.description:
- Developed API demo app with JavaScript and Angular to help major retailers integrate the Quotient platform on their website, ensuring retention of $10M+ in annual contracts across 8 major retail chains.
- Created banner and product sponsored ads with JavaScript that inserts into native search and browses results for 8 separate major retail chain sites with annual visits of over 500 million.
- Refactored legacy Java self service portal in response to major incidents to improve system uptime by 10%.
- Copiloted conversion of ad template engine from legacy Freemarker to Angular saving ~$180k in lost developer productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer - TypeScript, Angular, Java, Spring
positions.description:
- Bootstrapped development environment for greenfield project to use modern TypeScript and JavaScript tooling to support software built for Air Force defense contracts valued at over $80M.
- Converted legacy Air Force maintenance scheduling application from Java to TypeScript and Angular.

positions.title: Software Engineer - TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Developed reactive TypeScript and Angular forms for credit approval flow using RxJS to interface with a REST API, enabling loans of ~$600M annually spread across 500+ retail locations nationwide.
- Integrated Angular application form with a TypeScript SDK for 3rd party ecommerce shopping carts.  Projected to increase annual volume by 15% through transition from in store to ecommerce for ~$80M revenue increase.   
- Engineered JavaScript service to open a modal window to securely pass shopping cart transaction data.
